title: muehlenbeckia complexa
intro: Muehlenbeckia complexa, commonly known as the Maidenhair Vine or Lattice Plant, is a perennial vine native to New Zealand and Australia. This plant is valued for its ability to reduce anxiety and stress levels, with documented health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Muehlenbeckia complexa are attributed to its ability to promote relaxation, reduce inflammation, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
